About us

A China-based sourcing desk for Saudi auto parts wholesalers.

China-based automotive sourcing, export, quality inspection, and private label solutions for Saudi wholesale buyers. We connect Saudi wholesale buyers with suitable Chinese factories, inspection workflows, private label packaging, and export support.

How INCAR builds trust

A sourcing partner should make the review process clear.

INCAR uses practical trust pillars to help Saudi wholesale buyers understand what is reviewed, coordinated, and prepared before an RFQ or Private Label inquiry moves forward.

China sourcing advantage

INCAR helps Saudi buyers compare Chinese supplier options, coordinate samples, and review practical MOQ and packaging requirements.

Factory verification

Supplier review focuses on category fit, production capability, communication readiness, lead time, and export support.

Quality inspection approach

The inspection approach supports sample review, product consistency checks, packaging inspection, label verification, and pre-shipment checking.

Export support

INCAR assists with product information, packing details, invoice and packing list support, and shipment document coordination.

Saudi market focus

The platform is built around Saudi wholesale RFQ behavior, WhatsApp-friendly communication, and focused Toyota and Hyundai launch programs.

Private Label capability

Private Label support covers packaging coordination, logo placement, barcode and label checks, factory matching, and export preparation.
